regions.merged_text: Rev. Fr. Bonaventure Frey O.M. Cap. dies in Detroit, Mich. aged 81 yrs. Ordained May 25, 1854 the deceased was more than 58 yrs a priest. In 1856 arrived in America after a troubled voyage of 49 days. Since that year Rev. Fr. Bonaventure labored untireingly in the cloister, on missions, and establishing parishes, schools & monasteries. The Sacred Heart Monastery is the 13th that he started. This was in 1891. His mortal remains were taken to Mt. Calvery cemetery near Fond du Lac, Wisconsin. R.I.P.
